title: CYCLIC-BLOCKROOT: square-root block decoding and separately capped denser small-modulus roots — explicit positive-phase supplier revision

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the single CYCLIC-BLOCKROOT algorithm in the supplied full proofs recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. Jointly on every execution branch, its total charged sequential work T is O(n^3 2^J(n)). Here J(n)=a sqrt(n)+(9/2)sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^2-7sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^4+23sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^6 and F(n)=a sqrt(n)-(5/2)sqrt(n)/(log2 n)+6sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^2, with exact Pell rational  of cyclic_base.md Section 0. These eventual positive representative envelopes are evaluated for n>=2^4096 and extended positively on the finite smaller prefix; correctness applies to every N. All constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. The single configuration fixes h=max(1,floor(isqrt(n)/8192)), t=ceil(log2(n+2)), Dcut=2^20(h+t+1)^2, root length lambda(b)=2b+2t+40, base scale 8/9, denser seed increment 2t, denser SMALL scored roots, and the two actual recomputed typed acquisition caps 4096 U_seed and 4096 U_other of proof.md. All maxima, decoder modes/precisions, extraction confidences and finite branches use these actual parameters. Every failed, rejected, discarded and cutoff-abandoned acquisition counts. The exact growth index is 1/2. Every power-of-two leaf explicitly applies X to its original control once after LE, giving the positive phase used by wide-block readout.
